headline: European Gas Prices Rise 2.5% to €86.59 Per Megawatt-Hour in Amsterdam
summary: Dutch TTF natural gas futures opened 2.55% higher at €86.59 per megawatt-hour on the Amsterdam exchange, driven by renewed supply concerns across European energy markets.
why: Dutch TTF futures serve as the main European benchmark for natural gas pricing, directly influencing electricity generation and household heating costs.

impacts.name: TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: TTF gas benchmark contracts opened 2.55% higher due to supply tightness.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Supply constraints in European distribution networks pushed wholesale natural gas futures higher.
